label: History
value: After traveling through underground realms, he eventually reached the surface kingdom of Oz.
unit: After formerly ruling the Emerald City for many years and overseeing its construction, the Wizard left the Land of Oz and returned to Omaha. Finding his old friends gone or deceased, he rejoined the circus as a balloonist for Bailum & Barney's Great Consolidated Shows. During a balloon ascension, an earthquake caused him to fall into a deep crack in the earth, descending into the subterranean Land of the Mangaboos. There, he reunited with Dorothy Gale and met the Prince and the local Sorcerer. After traveling through underground realms, including the Valley of Voe, he eventually reached the surface kingdom of Oz once again. Upon his return, Princess Ozma offered him a permanent home as the Official Wizard of her kingdom, which he accepted with emotional gratitude.

value: > On earth I was a manufacturer of Imported Holes for American Swiss Cheese, and I will acknowledge that I supplied a superior article, which was in great demand.

passages.v04:c13:p0041: "I could not help it. It is a sad story, but if you will try to restrain your tears I will tell you about it. On earth I was a manufacturer of Imported Holes for American Swiss Cheese, and I will acknowledge that I supplied a superior article, which was in great demand. Also I made pores for porous plasters and high-grade holes for doughnuts and buttons. Finally I invented a new Adjustable Post-hole, which I thought would make my fortune. I manufactured a large quantity of these post-holes, and having no room in which to store them I set them all end to end and put the top one in the ground. That made an extraordinary long hole, as you may imagine, and reached far down into the earth; and, as I leaned over it to try to see to the bottom, I lost my balance and tumbled in. Unfortunately, the hole led directly into the vast space you see outside this mountain; but I managed to catch a point of rock that projected from this cavern, and so saved myself from tumbling headlong into the black waves beneath, where the tongues of flame that dart out would certainly have consumed me. Here, then, I made my home; and although it is a lonely place I amuse myself making rustles and flutters, and so get along very nicely."

label: History
value: The purpose of the enchantment was to fool Glinda's forces
unit: Mombi lived in the Country of the Gillikins, where she was suspected of practicing magical arts and raised the youth named Tip. In the past, the Wizard of Oz visited her three times to entrust her with the baby Princess Ozma, whom Mombi enchanted and transformed into a boy. In exchange, the Wizard taught Mombi all of his magical tricks. Later, when Glinda demanded that Queen Jinjur surrender Mombi, Mombi performed an enchantment that made Jellia Jamb resemble her and vice versa to fool Glinda's forces. After Glinda saw through the fraud, Mombi advised Jinjur to allow Glinda to search the city under a time limit, during which Mombi transformed herself into a red rose on a palace rosebush. The Tin Woodman unknowingly plucked the rose and carried Mombi out of the city into Glinda's camp. Upon discovery, Glinda interrogated Mombi using a magic truth-revealing pearl, forcing Mombi to confess that she had transformed Princess Ozma into Tip.

He pulled their buggy through various underground lands, eventually arriving in the Land of Oz. Dissatisfied with being offered cooked soup, fish, or roasted quail, he demanded uncooked oatmeal, which the Royal Steward had prepared for him in a tub. The next morning, Jim went out to find grass and encountered the Sawhorse, with whom he debated the nature and merits of a real horse versus a wooden imitation. She always wore a simple white costume, that suited all the heads. unit: Eureka accompanied Dorothy Gale, Zeb, Jim the cab-horse, and the Wizard during their subterranean journeys following a sudden earthquake. When her party was captured and imprisoned in the wooden city of the Gargoyles, Eureka carelessly wandered off by climbing down the outer walls of their prison to observe the inhabitants removing their wings to rest. Later, as the group traversed a dark cavern, Eureka used her keen night vision to identify dangerous dragonettes trapped in rock pockets, warning her companions of the threat. label: History
value: Tiktok was manufactured by the firm Smith & Tinker.
unit: Tiktok was manufactured by the firm Smith & Tinker in Evna as an automatic mechanical clockwork person equipped with separate mechanisms for thought, speech, and action. After being purchased by King Ev-oldo of the Land of Ev, he was eventually locked inside a concealed rock cavern atop a seaside mound. Dorothy Gale discovered the secret chamber and used a golden key to unlock the stone door, where she found the idle copper man. After being wound up, Tiktok pledged his service to Dorothy and accompanied her and Billina through the Land of Ev. Along the way, he defended them from the mischievous Wheelers by capturing their leader and forcing him to clear a path. He guided Dorothy to Princess Langwidere's palace, where he helped secure an audience. Later, he joined Princess Ozma's expeditionary force to the Nome King's underground realm to rescue the captive Queen of Ev and her children. During diplomatic negotiations, Tiktok advised Ozma on how to address the Nome King politely and assured the party of the monarch's underlying honesty.

label: History
value: Because Dorothy bore the kiss of the Good Witch, neither the Monkeys nor the Wicked Witch could harm her directly.
unit: The Wicked Witch of the West ruled over the Winkies in the uncultivated Country of the West, keeping the local population in servitude. When Dorothy Gale and her companions traveled into her territory to destroy her, the Witch spotted them from her castle door using her single telescopic eye. She blew her silver whistle to send a pack of forty great wolves to tear them to pieces, but the Tin Woodman slaughtered the entire pack. Next, she summoned a flock of wild crows to peck out their eyes, but they too were slain. She then sent her slaves to attack, but they were frightened away by the Cowardly Lion. Having exhausted her other options, the Witch donned the Golden Cap and invoked its magical charm for the third and final time, summoning the Winged Monkeys. She commanded them to destroy the Scarecrow and Tin Woodman, capture the Lion to harness him like a horse, and bring Dorothy to her castle. Because Dorothy bore the kiss of the Good Witch and wore the Silver Shoes, neither the Monkeys nor the Wicked Witch could harm her directly, so the Witch forced Dorothy into kitchen labor while holding the Lion prisoner in a fenced yard. After tricking Dorothy to steal one of her Silver Shoes, Dorothy threw a bucket of water over her in anger, causing the Wicked Witch of the West to melt completely away.

passages.v02:c09:p0049: “Because they are one and the same!” declared the girl, now laughing merrily. “Does not your Majesty know that in all the land of Oz but one language is spoken?”

label: History
value: The Nome King transformed the ten children of the Queen of Ev into decorative ornaments in his underground palace
unit: The Nome King rules over a vast subterranean kingdom populated by thousands of rock-fairies and an army of mail-clad Nomes. Having enchanted the Queen of Ev and her ten children, he transformed them into decorative ornaments in his underground palace. When Princess Ozma, Dorothy Gale, and their companions arrived to rescue the royal family, he offered a game in which guests could try to identify the transformed family members, with the catch that failure resulted in the guessers becoming ornaments themselves. After Ozma, the Tin Woodman, and all 26 officers failed and were transformed, the Nome King retreated to his throne room to await further attempts. Later, his face distorted in rage, he mobilized his massive steel-clad army to confront his remaining visitors in his domed cavern.

passages.v03:c15:p0046: This important monarch of the Underground World was a little fat man clothed in gray-brown garments that were the exact color of the rock throne in which he was seated. His bushy hair and flowing beard were also colored like the rocks, and so was his face. He wore no crown of any sort, and his only ornament was a broad, jewel-studded belt that encircled his fat little body. As for his features, they seemed kindly and good humored, and his eyes were turned merrily upon his visitors as Ozma and Dorothy stood before him with their followers ranged in close order behind them.
passages.v03:c15:p0053: "Your Majesty," said she, "I am the ruler of the Land of Oz, and I have come here to ask you to release the good Queen of Ev and her ten children, whom you have enchanted and hold as your prisoners."
passages.v03:c15:p0078: Although this tremendous army consisted of rock-colored Nomes, all squat and fat, they were clothed in glittering armor of polished steel, inlaid with beautiful gems. Upon his brow each wore a brilliant electric light, and they bore sharp spears and swords and battle-axes of solid bronze. It was evident they were perfectly trained, for they stood in straight rows, rank after rank, with their weapons held erect and true, as if awaiting but the word of command to level them upon their foes.
passages.v03:c15:p0091: "I am very anxious," she continued, "to liberate the Queen of Ev and her children who are now ornaments and bric-a-brac in your Majesty's palace, and to restore them to their people. Tell me, sir, how this may be accomplished."
passages.v03:c15:p0095: "Then," said the Nome King, "I will make you this offer: You shall go alone and unattended into my palace and examine carefully all that the rooms contain. Then you shall have permission to touch eleven different objects, pronouncing at the time the word 'Ev,' and if any one of them, or more than one, proves to be the transformation of the Queen of Ev or any of her ten children, then they will instantly be restored to their true forms and may leave my palace and my kingdom in your company, without any objection whatever. It is possible for you, in this way, to free the entire eleven; but if you do not guess all the objects correctly, and some of the slaves remain transformed, then each one of your friends and followers may, in turn, enter the palace and have the same privileges I grant you."
passages.v03:c15:p0099: "If none of the eleven objects you touch proves to be the transformation of any of the royal family of Ev, then, instead of freeing them, you will yourself become enchanted, and transformed into an article of bric-a-brac or an ornament. This is only fair and just, and is the risk you declared you were willing to take."

screen.reason: The passages indicate that the Queen of Ev and her ten children are enchanted and held as prisoners in the form of ornaments or bric-a-brac in the Nome King's palace.
